label: ERISA non-health plan (disability, pension)
out_of_scope_reason: Recourse computes health-plan appeal clocks and has no clock table for disability or pension claims.

time_to_appeal.note: 29 CFR 2560.503-1(h)(2)(i): at least 60 days, not the 180 days a group health plan allows under (h)(3)(i). This file exists to be refused with the right number in the message; it deliberately ships no other clocks.
